spells.name: Magic Missile
spells.desc: Fires several slow magic projectiles at nearby targets. Hits paralyze the target and deal minor damage.

spells.name: Fireball
spells.desc: Fires a fireball in the direction you're facing; does not require wizard garb. Beware close-range casting.

spells.name: Disable Technology
spells.desc: Disables all weapons, cameras and most other technology in range.

spells.name: Smoke
spells.desc: Spawns a cloud of choking smoke at your location; does not require wizard garb.

spells.name: Blind
spells.desc: Temporarily blinds a single person; does not require wizard garb.

spells.name: Subjugation
spells.desc: Temporarily subjugates a target's mind; does not require wizard garb.

spells.name: Forcewall
spells.desc: Creates an unbreakable wall that lasts 30 seconds; does not require wizard garb.

spells.name: Blink
spells.desc: Randomly teleports you a short distance. Useful for evasion or sneaking with patience.

spells.name: Teleport
spells.desc: Teleports you to an area of your selection. Useful when in danger, but unpredictable.

spells.name: Mutate
spells.desc: Briefly transforms you into a hulk and grants telekinesis.

spells.name: Ethereal Jaunt
spells.desc: Creates your ethereal form, temporarily making you invisible and able to pass through walls.

spells.name: Knock
spells.desc: Opens nearby doors; does not require wizard garb.

artefacts.name: Mental Focus
artefacts.desc: An artefact that channels the user's will into destructive bolts of force.

artefacts.name: Six Soul Stone Shards and the spell Artificer
artefacts.desc: Soul Stone Shards capture the spirits of the dead and dying. Artificer lets the captured souls pilot arcane machines.

artefacts.name: Mastercrafted Armor Set
artefacts.desc: Armor that allows you to cast spells while granting more protection against attacks and the void of space.

artefacts.name: Staff of Animation
artefacts.desc: An arcane staff that fires bolts of eldritch energy which animate inanimate objects. Doesn't affect machines.

artefacts.name: Scrying Orb
artefacts.desc: Lets you ghost while alive to spy upon the station. Also permanently grants x-ray vision.

noclothes.name: Remove Clothes Requirement
noclothes.desc: Lets you cast your spells without wizard garb. Costs two spell choices.
